content: Thank you for showing interest in the WikInfect Project. The WikInfect Project provides comprehensive information on anti-infective agents, derived from FDA package inserts, as well as treatment recommendations for infections based on organ systems and specific pathogens. These recommendations are developed using established guidelines, consensus statements, review articles, and expert opinions curated by the Infection Mission Force (IMF) team. The information presented is not intended to replace clinical judgment but rather to serve as a supplementary resource. If there is specific or more detailed information you would like to see included, please do not hesitate to let us know. The IMF team welcomes your feedback and can be reached via email.
